cases.title: Rainbow wax
cases.target_prompt: Thick marbled multicolored fluid pours from above, spills over the mug rim, drips down the sides, and eventually coats the entire white ceramic mug.
cases.reference_prompt: The man standing on the path remains motionless, as a rainbow-colored viscous fluid falls from above, spreads over his head and flows downwards, eventually coating his entire upper body with dripping edges.

cases.title: Paint wings
cases.target_prompt: The woman remains standing still, as colorful fluid-like wings gradually grow out from her shoulders, expanding outward until they form a full vivid pair of artistic wings with paint dripping edges.
cases.reference_prompt: The woman stays still in the empty room, as colorful fluid strips emerge from her left wrist, gradually extending and branching out to finally form a pair of vibrant translucent butterfly wings.

cases.title: Ribbons
cases.target_prompt: Colorful long ribbons emerge from the woman's shoulders, gradually stretch out and float around her, while she slowly turns her head to face the camera.
cases.reference_prompt: The Border Collie stays completely still as red, blue, green and purple ribbons fly in from outside the frame, wrapping around its whole body with their ends fluttering outward.

cases.title: Butterflies
cases.target_prompt: The man stands still as numerous orange-yellow butterflies gradually emerge from all around the space, fly and gather, swirling and surging through the air around him in the warm sunlit high-rise room.
cases.reference_prompt: The standing woman stays completely motionless, while numerous warm-glowing butterflies emerge from faint light behind her, keep increasing in number and flutter freely around her body.

cases.title: Sunset
cases.target_prompt: The overcast riverside scene gradually shifts from cool grey tones to warm orange sunset lighting, the entire river and landscape are bathed in golden glow, while pedestrians walk across the distant stone bridge.
cases.reference_prompt: The golden retriever stops to sniff the grass, while the overcast sky gradually transitions to a warm sunset, with golden sunlight spreading across the lawn and casting long soft shadows.

cases.title: Firefly swarm
cases.target_prompt: The man remains standing still, while numerous glowing firefly-like light points emerge from all edges of the frame and fly gently throughout the entire concrete colonnade space.
cases.reference_prompt: The grey cylindrical canister stays still on the wooden table, while numerous tiny warm yellow glowing light spots emerge and float slowly in loops around the canister across the table surface.

cases.title: Ember swirl
cases.target_prompt: The static shot shows bright orange glowing sparks emerging from the base of the gray bollard, swirling and rising upwards around the pillar continuously.
cases.reference_prompt: The Border Collie remains seated completely still, while orange-gold spark particles emerge from the floor, spiraling upwards around the dog's body to form a bright glowing vortex.

cases.title: Head inflation
cases.target_prompt: The sitting beagle keeps its body completely still, while its head and neck area gradually inflate and expand outward evenly, finally turning into a huge round spherical oversized head with a calm expression.
cases.reference_prompt: The Shiba Inu stays seated motionless, its head gradually inflates and expands outward, finally turning into a huge smooth sphere with its facial features remaining on the front of the sphere.

cases.title: Rock armor
cases.target_prompt: Scattered stone fragments rise up sequentially from the floor, assembling from feet to torso to fully cover the man's body into a blocky stone armored figure, while his original human head remains unchanged.
cases.reference_prompt: The chestnut horse stays still on the concrete, as floating stone fragments rise and assemble to cover its torso and limbs, leaving only its original brown head exposed.

cases.title: Stone camouflage
cases.target_prompt: The sitting black Labrador retriever gradually transforms from its left side to the right, turning entirely into a stone statue with the same masonry texture as the background stone wall, remaining seated the whole time.
cases.reference_prompt: The sitting black German Shepherd gradually transforms from left to right into a cracked stone statue of a dog that matches the texture of the background stone wall, remaining seated and facing forward.

cases.title: Day-to-night wipe
cases.target_prompt: A vertical split line moves steadily from the left to the right of the frame, gradually replacing the bright daytime riverside scene with the same viewpoint's night scene, finally showing the full night view with lit buildings and light reflections on the river.
cases.reference_prompt: The golden retriever lowers its head slightly, a left-to-right wipe transition replaces the daytime residential street with the identical night scene, with lit house windows and glowing streetlights.

cases.title: Musical wings
cases.target_prompt: The woman slowly raises her right hand palm up, glowing musical notes fly out from her palm, then gather behind her and assemble into a pair of luminous wings made of glowing notes that fully spread out.
cases.reference_prompt: Golden glowing musical note particles emerge from the woman's hands, spread behind her, and gradually assemble into a pair of fully extended luminous wings made of glowing musical notes.

cases.title: Particle tunnel
cases.target_prompt: In the backyard lawn, the light yellow Labrador stops moving, glowing fine particles emerge in mid-air, assemble and swirl to form an extending luminous ring tunnel that slowly moves toward the dog.
cases.reference_prompt: The black robot slowly turns its head to look at the background, where a particle ring emerges and expands into a deep swirling tunnel made of countless tiny glowing particles.

cases.title: Water splash
cases.target_prompt: The camera stays static, as water bursts out from under the concrete bench, splashing outward in all directions, eventually spreading across the tiled ground and leaving wet stains on the lower part of the bench.
cases.reference_prompt: The man remains standing still the whole time. A large circular splash bursts out from the ground in front of him, rises to its peak, then falls back down and forms a circular puddle on the pavement.

cases.title: Feathered wings
cases.target_prompt: A young East Asian woman with long wavy black hair, wearing a white slip dress printed with orange floral and green leaf patterns, is initially seated in profile facing right in a soft blurred green grassy outdoor environment, with no wings visible behind her. She slowly straightens her upper body from the initial hunched seated position, tilting her head upward to gaze toward the upper right. Large, layered pure white feathered wings gradually emerge and spread fully from behind her back on both sides. Her arms extend gently outward to her sides, a few strands of her long hair drift slightly, and she holds the upward-gazing pose as the wings reach their fully spread state.
cases.reference_prompt: A middle-aged East Asian man wearing black-rimmed glasses, a bright blue floral short-sleeve shirt, dark trousers, and a wristwatch stands on a dirt path in a lush green forest. Initially he faces directly toward the camera, with his left hand tucked into his pants pocket. As he slowly turns his body and head to look toward the right side of the frame, a pair of large, layered pure white feathered wings emerges and fully spreads out from behind his back, extending upward and outward on both sides. The camera stays fixed on the man for the entire sequence.

cases.title: Electromagnetic charging
cases.target_prompt: A young woman in a thick fluffy fur hat and textured brown woven outerwear stands before a woven straw wall. Initially she looks down, holding the edge of her shawl with both hands under warm golden light. She pulls the shawl open to reveal a glowing blue sword-shaped object held between her hands. As she lifts her gaze toward the camera, bright cyan-blue light radiates from the object, with winding electric arc-like light patterns spreading outward from its outline, forming swirling circular light vortices at both ends. The glow intensifies steadily, with fine luminous particles floating within the expanding light trails.
cases.reference_prompt: A muscular short-haired man in a black sleeveless tank top stands against a solid pure black background, initially facing the camera with his arms hanging naturally at his sides. He raises both hands, and a bright blue wireframe holographic rifle appears between his palms, with flowing blue electric-like light patterns wrapping around the gun body. He grips the glowing rifle with both hands, rotating it so the muzzle points toward the upper left of the frame. The light at the muzzle grows brighter, forming a swirling bright blue vortex, while branching blue filament light effects spread outward across the space around the gun and his hands.

cases.title: Swirling portal
cases.target_prompt: A young girl with twin braids, dressed in a white short-sleeve top and dark pleated skirt, is initially kneeling on grass beside a calm golden-hour riverside, her hands resting on a black bag on the ground as she looks back toward the camera. As she rises to stand, a massive swirling golden-brown vortex cloud emerges in the sky behind her, streaked with glowing lightning-like golden lines, its bright luminous core radiating sharp white light beams outward. The girl spreads both arms fully out to her sides, her skirt fluttering in the wind, as the vortex expands, its lower dust clouds spreading across the distant horizon.
cases.reference_prompt: A middle-aged man with graying facial hair, dressed in a light blue button-down shirt, light gray trousers, black belt and polished black dress shoes, stands in a gym lined with weight training equipment. He pulls his left hand from his trouser pocket, extends both arms fully out to his sides, and bends his knees into a wide stable stance. A glowing warm-gold circular light effect emerges directly behind him, expanding outward to fully replace the original gym background. The light develops into a rotating spiral energy vortex, with a bright white core at its center, and purple-blue electric streaks appearing along its swirling edges as it continues to spin.
